facts.business: Contil India Limited is engaged in the export and trading of food and grocery products such as spices, cereals, pulses, namkeen, snacks, papad, edible oils, beauty, ayurvedic and household articles, primarily to the Indian diaspora in Canada and the United States under its own brands.

segments.name: Food and grocery trading (spices, cereals, pulses, namkeen, snacks, papad, edible oils, beauty, ayurvedic, household articles)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management's stated focus on deepening its presence in the United States, alongside its established Canadian distribution network, is expected to support the Company's medium-term growth.
Near-term priority will be to restore core trading profitability through disciplined procurement and cost management.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts

key_risks: Revenue and profitability concentration risk given reliance on Canada/North America as principal export market
Volatility in agricultural commodity prices driven by monsoon and climate variability
Currency fluctuation risk on Canadian Dollar/US Dollar-denominated export revenue
Tightening food-safety and pesticide-residue regulations in key importing markets
Rising freight costs and shipping-route disruptions
Meaningful share of FY 2025-26 profitability contributed by other income rather than core operating profit
facts.related_party_note: Mrs. Sejal Contractor is wife of Mr. Krishna Contractor. No other related party transactions disclosed in the provided excerpts.
